name: Saint Seiya: Starstorm
overview: An unaired live-action pilot produced by Renaissance Atlantic in 1994, adapting Saint Seiya for a Western audience. Five young warriors are chosen by the mysterious Om(n)icron and granted Star Armors to rescue the captive goddess Karina from the tyrant Bellatrix. The pilot went unreleased for decades until YouTuber Ray Mona uploaded it in August 2024 as part of her documentary on Saint Seiya lost media.
